metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the sophia name detail page on babycenter.com. Uses existing evaluator is_expected_active_tab with active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the agent reached the correct URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction: Instruction 'Search for the name Sophia' requires navigating to the Sophia name detail page, which the evaluator checks via URL verification

Complete coverage: The getter (active_url_from_accessTree) extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree, and the metric (is_expected_active_tab) compares it against the expected Sophia detail page URL (https://www.babycenter.com/baby-names/details/sophia-19481)
Expected value is semantically correct: The URL https://www.babycenter.com/baby-names/details/sophia-19481 is the correct detail page for the name 'Sophia' on babycenter.com

Edge cases handled properly: If Chrome is not active, getter returns None and metric returns 0.0; if wrong page is loaded, URL comparison fails correctly; accessibility tree extraction has proper error handling
